name: FamilyTreeNow

search.notes: No site URL pattern was confirmed, so search Google for the name on this domain and open the listing in a browser.

steps: Open the official privacy page and follow its Opt-Out Form link.
Review your own first name, last name, email and the communications authorization. Leave agent and optional middle-name fields empty.
Complete the genuine hCaptcha and submit the initial Privacy Request form.
Follow the broker email and later matching instructions. An initial submission or email receipt is not a verified removal.
optout.notes: The November 5 initial form posts to /optout/beginoptoutidv. The request-subject option, contact authorization, opaque anti-forgery token, hidden false checkbox fallback and genuine hCaptcha controls were observed. No personal data or live request was submitted; subsequent email, matching, processing and deletion stages are unverified.
